name: Securities Pricing
definition: Characteristics related to the price of the security.

PriceType.name: Price Type
PriceType.definition: Type and information about a price.

CumDividendIndicator.name: Cum Dividend Indicator
CumDividendIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the dividend is included, ie, cum-dividend, in the executed price. When the dividend is not included, the price will be ex-dividend.

CalculationBasis.name: Calculation Basis
CalculationBasis.definition: Ratio applied on the non-adjusted price.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Price expressed as a rate, ie, percentage.

Yielded.name: Yielded
Yielded.definition: Indicates whether the price is expressed as a yield (yield is the annual rate of return expressed as a percentage).

TypeOfRate.name: Type Of Rate
TypeOfRate.definition: Type of value in which the price (as a rate)  is expressed.

TypeOfAmount.name: Type Of Amount
TypeOfAmount.definition: Type of value in which the price (as a rate)  is expressed.

QuotationDate.name: Quotation Date
QuotationDate.definition: Date on which the price is obtained.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date/time of the price. For CIV, this is the NAV date.

PriceChangeRelatedStatistics.name: Price Change Related Statistics
PriceChangeRelatedStatistics.definition: Valuation statistics for which a change of price is specified.

HighestPriceValueRelatedStatistics.name: Highest Price Value Related Statistics
HighestPriceValueRelatedStatistics.definition: Valuation statistics for which a highest price value is specified.

LowestPriceValueRelatedStatistics.name: Lowest Price Value Related Statistics
LowestPriceValueRelatedStatistics.definition: Valuation statistics for which a lowest price value is specified.

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Identifies the security for which a price is given.

SecuritiesTradeExecution.name: Securities Trade Execution
SecuritiesTradeExecution.definition: Trade execution for which a deal price is specified.

Derivative.name: Derivative
Derivative.definition: Derivative for which an exercise price is specified.

RelatedWarrant.name: Related Warrant
RelatedWarrant.definition: Warrant for which a subscription price is provided.

RelatedSecuritiesConversion.name: Related Securities Conversion
RelatedSecuritiesConversion.definition: Securities conversion process for which a conversion price is specified.

LotBreakdown.name: Lot Breakdown
LotBreakdown.definition: Lot for which a price is specified.

ExercisePriceRelatedEvent.name: Exercise Price Related Event
ExercisePriceRelatedEvent.definition: Corporate action event for which an exercise price is provided.

GenericCashPriceReceivedPerProductRelate.name: Generic Cash Price Received Per Product Related Event
GenericCashPriceReceivedPerProductRelate.definition: Corporate action event for which a generic cash price received per product is provided.

AmountPricePerFinancialInstrumentQuantit.name: Amount Price Per Financial Instrument Quantity
AmountPricePerFinancialInstrumentQuantit.definition: Price expressed as an amount per a quantity of financial instruments.

AmountPricePerAmount.name: Amount Price Per Amount
AmountPricePerAmount.definition: Price expressed as an amount per another amount.

GenericCashPricePaidPerProductRelatedEve.name: Generic Cash Price Paid Per Product Related Event
GenericCashPricePaidPerProductRelatedEve.definition: Corporate action event for which a generic cash price paid per product is provided.

PriceCalculationPeriod.name: Price Calculation Period
PriceCalculationPeriod.definition: Period during which the price of a security is determined (For outturn securities).

CashInLieuOfSharePriceRelatedEvent.name: Cash In Lieu Of Share Price Related Event
CashInLieuOfSharePriceRelatedEvent.definition: Corporate action event for which a cash in lieu of share price is provided.

OverSubscriptionDepositPriceRelatedEvent.name: Over Subscription Deposit Price Related Event
OverSubscriptionDepositPriceRelatedEvent.definition: Corporate action event for which an over subscription deposit price is provided.

CashValueForTaxRelatedEvent.name: Cash Value For Tax Related Event
CashValueForTaxRelatedEvent.definition: Corporate action event for which a cash value has been provided.

MaximumPriceBiddingConditions.name: Maximum Price Bidding Conditions
MaximumPriceBiddingConditions.definition: Bidding conditions for which a maximum price is specified.

MinimumPriceBiddingConditions.name: Minimum Price Bidding Conditions
MinimumPriceBiddingConditions.definition: Bidding conditions for which a minimum price is specified.

YieldCalculation.name: Yield Calculation
YieldCalculation.definition: Rate of return on an investment, based on the price.

RelatedSecuritiesFinancing.name: Related Securities Financing
RelatedSecuritiesFinancing.definition: Securities financing process for which an end price is specified.

FundOrderRelatedToExecutedPrice.name: Fund Order Related To Executed Price
FundOrderRelatedToExecutedPrice.definition: Fund order for which an executed price is specified.

FundOrderRelatedToInformativePrice.name: Fund Order Related To Informative Price
FundOrderRelatedToInformativePrice.definition: Fund order for which an informative price is specified.

TaxVoucher.name: Tax Voucher
TaxVoucher.definition: Tax voucher for which the cost per share is specified.

SecuritiesTrade.name: Securities Trade
SecuritiesTrade.definition: Trade for which the trade price is calculated.

NetAssetValueCalculation.name: Net Asset Value Calculation
NetAssetValueCalculation.definition: Value calculation for which a securities pricing is specified.

RelatedBuyIn.name: Related Buy In
RelatedBuyIn.definition: BuyIn process for which a price is specified.

Index.name: Index
Index.definition: Specifies the index information when used for calculating the price.

PriceFactPeriod.name: Price Fact Period
PriceFactPeriod.definition: Period during which the price fact type is valid.

AnalyticsCalculation.name: Analytics Calculation
AnalyticsCalculation.definition: Calculated analytics based on the price.

DurationCalculation.name: Duration Calculation
DurationCalculation.definition: Calculated duration based on the price.

LifeCalculation.name: Life Calculation
LifeCalculation.definition: Calculated  life based on the price.

Spread.name: Spread
Spread.definition: Spread which uses the price as benchmark.

Order.name: Order
Order.definition: Securities order for which a price is specified.

StopPriceOrder.name: Stop Price Order
StopPriceOrder.definition: Order for which a stop price is specified.

Allocation.name: Allocation
Allocation.definition: Allocation process for which a price is specified.

RelatedOrder.name: Related Order
RelatedOrder.definition: Order for which a previous closing price is specified.

Issuance.name: Issuance
Issuance.definition: Issuance for which a discount is specified.

Entitlement.name: Entitlement
Entitlement.definition: Entitlement for which a strike price is specified.

CashFractionsPriceRelatedSecuritiesDistr.name: Cash Fractions Price Related Securities Distribution
CashFractionsPriceRelatedSecuritiesDistr.definition: Securities distribution for which a cash fractions price is provided.

SuscriptionPriceRelatedSecuritiesDistrib.name: Suscription Price Related Securities Distribution
SuscriptionPriceRelatedSecuritiesDistrib.definition: Securities distribution for which a subscription price is provided.

ReinvestmentPriceRelatedSecuritiesDistri.name: Reinvestment Price Related Securities Distribution
ReinvestmentPriceRelatedSecuritiesDistri.definition: Securities distribution for which a reinvestment price is provided.

RelatedFuture.name: Related Future
RelatedFuture.definition: Contract for which a tick is specified.

Distribution.name: Distribution
Distribution.definition: Distribution for which an offer price is specified.

PriceChangeRedemptionSchedule.name: Price Change Redemption Schedule
PriceChangeRedemptionSchedule.definition: Redemption schedule for which a change in price is provided.

RelatedRedemptionSchedule.name: Related Redemption Schedule
RelatedRedemptionSchedule.definition: Redemption schedule for which a price is specified.

PreviousClosingPriceRelatedQuote.name: Previous Closing Price Related Quote
PreviousClosingPriceRelatedQuote.definition: Quote which contains a previous closing price.

RequestedPriceRelatedQuote.name: Requested Price Related Quote
RequestedPriceRelatedQuote.definition: Quote which contains a requested price.

MarketPriceRelatedQuote.name: Market Price Related Quote
MarketPriceRelatedQuote.definition: Quote which contains a market price.

RelatedCorporateActionPrice.name: Related Corporate Action Price
RelatedCorporateActionPrice.definition: Corporate action price for which pricing information is provided.

RelatedPosition.name: Related Position
RelatedPosition.definition: Position for which a price is provided.

MinimumCashToInstructRelatedEvent.name: Minimum Cash To Instruct Related Event
MinimumCashToInstructRelatedEvent.definition: Corporate action event for which a minimum cash is instructed.

MaximumCashToInstructRelatedEvent.name: Maximum Cash To Instruct Related Event
MaximumCashToInstructRelatedEvent.definition: Corporate action event for which a maximum cash is instructed.

MinimumMultipleCashToInstructRelatedEven.name: Minimum Multiple Cash To Instruct Related Event
MinimumMultipleCashToInstructRelatedEven.definition: Corporate action event for which a minimum multiple cash is instructed.
